notes.title: Lilith Rising: Season 2 – Major Update & Important Crash Fix Notice
notes.content:
[h1] Lilith Rising: Season 2 – Patch Notes and Known Issues [/h1]  

Dear Adventurers,  

The Jubei Games team has been hard at work improving *Lilith Rising: Season 2* to deliver an even better gameplay experience! This update brings several fixes and enhancements to the game. Here's what's new:  

[hr][/hr]  

[h2] [b] What's New [/b] [/h2]  

[list]  
[*] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Resolved most visual glitches, and achievements now unlock correctly.  
[*] [b]Translation Overhaul:[/b] All in-game text has been thoroughly proofread and retranslated for a smoother and more immersive experience.  
[*] [b]Text-Image Sync:[/b] Dialogue and visuals are now perfectly aligned for seamless storytelling.  
[/list]  

[hr][/hr]  

[h2] [b] Known Issue – Crash After Mage Tower Mission [/b] [/h2]  

We are aware of a crash issue that occurs after the Mage Tower mission. This happens when loading a save made before this update. Please rest assured that we are actively working to identify and fix the root cause of this bug.  

[b][u]Our Recommendation:[/u][/b] To fully enjoy the updated content, we strongly encourage players to restart the game and experience the polished story from the beginning. This update significantly improves the game, and the refined narrative is absolutely worth revisiting!  

[b][u]Quick Fix:[/u][/b] If you prefer not to restart, you can use the "Skip" feature (hold [b]Ctrl[/b] key) to fast-forward to where you left off.  

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience and understanding as we continue to improve the game.  

[hr][/hr]  

[h2] [b] Join the Discussion! [/b] [/h2]  

If you encounter other issues or have suggestions, please visit our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2864850/discussions/]Community Discussions page[/url]. Your feedback is vital to helping us make *Lilith Rising: Season 2* even better!  

Want to stay updated or interact with other players? Join our [url=https://discord.gg/8j3NkHD2qt style=button]Discord server[/url]!  

[hr][/hr]  

Thank you for your ongoing support, and we hope you enjoy your adventures in *Lilith Rising*!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914940/ae56e28cb54d8b1eb4f63ab34355125afd99590a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hope everyone had their fun playing Season 2, so a few quick updates here:[/h2]

[u][h3]Addressing the bugs and translation issues:[/h3][/u]Jubei has been busy fixing MOST of the game bugs and they should be rectified at this point as some of you may have noticed that there's a new patch for the game.

But if there are still bugs that are still occurring please remember to report it and notify us, or even better; join the [url=https://discord.gg/8j3NkHD2qt]Discord[/url] as we have a dedicated channel to report any bugs or issues there.

Besides that, the upcoming things that are looked into is the translations and proofreading as some players that are playing S2 in other languages had some English dialogue popping up randomly. 

[u][h3]Non-Steam build:[/h3][/u]Lastly, for Patreon members who are above the $15 tier, the non-Steam build can be downloaded [url=https://www.oppaiman.com/download/Lilith_Rising_Season_2/Lilith_Rising_2-2.0.11ns_zip?utm_source=jubeigames&utm_campaign=Lilith_Rising_Season_2&utm_medium=download]here[/url]

Nonetheless, [b]thank you everyone for submitting their feedbacks and the bug reports[/b] and due to that the game is going to be far more polished than ever and giving both existing and new players a better experience on finishing the sequel.

notes.content:
[h3]First of all, we'd like to thank everyone for their anticipation and participation of the launch for Lilith Rising Season 2.[/h3]

[h3]But unfortunately, we had some hiccups while trying to get Steam to greenlight some stuff and since the game is still under review by Steam, and this forces us to postpone the release.

notes.title: Lilith Rising - Season 2 - First Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914940/b2e70eb8c533265df267ec2079fc5d1a0c4be211.png[/img]

Hi friends,

This is quick update, from our Game Director:

Hi everyone, first I personally and the entire team truly appreciate your support in our game, your feedback is invaluable for us, to make the game better for everyone to enjoy.

On to Season 2 Update:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2864850/Lilith_Rising__Season_2/]The Steam page is live, and we officially started the marketing campaign for season 2![/url]

Season 2 is planned for release on Q3 of 2024, so hopefully we can release before September.

We’ve hired a team of Rendering Artists (4), a Programmer, and a 2D Artist, in addition to the Composer, Community Manager, Marketing and our Game Director (Jubei). So we’re now a team of 10!

Production is faster and better than ever!

Season 2 will have at least 2x (twice) more content than Season 1. It will have 8 episodes, each will have a unique adventure, an opportunity for a date, and romance with one of the girls.

We’re now estimating about 6-8 hours of gameplay, but until we finish production and actually test the game with beta testers it’s only a guesstimate.

If you wish to help out, you can send our new Steam page to your friends, and post anywhere so they will wishlist season 2 - on steam, this helps a-lot.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2864850/Lilith_Rising__Season_2/]Wishlist here[/url]

Thank you so much for your continuous support.

Jubei

Game Director
Jubei Games.
